ideas.pitch: Satellite-based flood risk and infrastructure monitoring dashboard tailored specifically for coastal urban centers like Miami.
ideas.title: MiamiSeaLevelSentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages technical difficulty by processing geospatial satellite data, mirroring the architectural approach of GeoNex-ATLAS which won 2nd runner up at Xcelerate Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: Computer vision pipeline that analyzes underwater drone footage to assess coral reef bleaching and structural degradation.
ideas.title: CoralGuardAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a localized environmental challenge heavily relevant to South Florida, appealing directly to judges looking for regional impact combined with computer vision.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent logistics orchestration platform for optimizing container cargo routing and customs clearance bottlenecks around PortMiami.
ideas.title: PortFlowMiami
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the multi-agent workflow pattern seen in GreenNovation AI Platform, providing clear business value to maritime supply chains.

ideas.pitch: Predictive time-series forecasting engine mapping microplastic concentration surges in Biscayne Bay using tidal and weather features.
ideas.title: BiscayneBayMicroplasticTracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs rigorous statistical forecasting with calibrated confidence intervals, directly replicating the methodology of the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: Localized vector-borne disease outbreak forecaster and clinical triage assistant built for subtropical urban environments.
ideas.title: TropicalHealthRiskAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines predictive modeling with localized healthcare utility, following the winning template of Global-Smile in rapid health-tech execution.
